caption: The drawing depicts a wooden articulated mannequin shaped like a seated human figure with fair skin tones on the face, hands, and feet, and a wood-like brown color on the torso, limbs, and joints. The mannequin’s joints, such as the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees, are clearly visible and segmented, allowing for movement. The head features painted details including eyes, eyebrows, a nose, lips, and short, neatly combed dark brown hair. The mannequin is positioned in a seated posture with its arms bent at the elbows and its legs bent at the knees, with bare feet slightly apart. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or details, focusing attention on the single central subject.
title: Wooden Doll - "Sadie Berman"
